headline: Bajaj Finance and Union Bank report strong Q2 profits while Waaree Renewable earnings decline

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% rise in Q2 consolidated net profit to Rs 6,367 crore
Union Bank of India saw a 30% increase in quarterly net profit to ₹5,537 crore
Waaree Renewable Technologies reported a 29% drop in net profit for the second quarter
Fairfax's IDBI Bank deal is expected to have limited impact on its $2.3 billion cushion
whatHappening: India flagged off its first consignment to New Zealand under a new free trade pact
MNRE Secretary expects India's agrivoltaic capacity to exceed 5-gigawatts in 3-4 years
Bajaj Finance is targeting up to 27% growth in FY27 despite marginal NIM moderation
Tata Trusts has replied to a complaint regarding SDTT with a decision expected soon
summary: Bajaj Finance and Union Bank of India posted robust Q2 profit growth of 29% and 30% respectively. Conversely, Waaree Renewable Technologies saw a significant 29% decline in quarterly earnings. The market is also monitoring India's new trade consignment to New Zealand and growth in the agrivoltaic sector.
